input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/wwmetagen/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

analysis_options.title: Analysis Workflow Options
analysis_options.description: Select which specific sub-analysis to execute.

analysis_type.description: The specific analysis mode to run.
analysis_type.help_text: Choose 'assembly' for de novo assembly, MAGs and AMR profiling, 'taxonomy' for Kraken2/Bracken, or 'alignment' for specific pathogen mapping (e.g. Vibrio/RVFV).

preprocessing_options.title: Preprocessing options
preprocessing_options.description: Parameters for quality control and adapter trimming using fastp.

window_size.description: The window size for sliding window quality sliding.
window_size.help_text: Used in conjunction with quality threshold to trim low-quality bases.

window_quality.description: The average quality threshold for the sliding window.
window_quality.help_text: Bases will be trimmed if the average quality drops below this value.

qualified_quality_phred.description: Instructs Fastp to apply the --qualified_quality_phred option
qualified_quality_phred.help_text: The quality value that a base is qualified. Default 30 means phred quality >=Q30 is qualified

unqualified_percent_limit.description: Instructs Fastp to apply the --unqualified_percent_limit option
unqualified_percent_limit.help_text: How many percents of bases are allowed to be unqualified (0~100). Default 10 means 10%

min_length.description: Instructs Fastp to drop the read if it is below a specified length
min_length.help_text: Reads below this length will be dropped

save_trimmed_reads.description: Save the trimmed FastQ files in the results directory.
save_trimmed_reads.help_text: By default, trimmed FastQ files will not be saved to the results directory. Specify this flag (or set to true in your config file) to copy these files to the results directory when complete.

save_trimmed_fail.help_text: By default, failed trimmed FastQ files will not be saved to the results directory. Specify this flag (or set to true in your config file) to copy these files to the results directory when complete.

trim_poly_g.help_text: Highly recommended for Illumina 2-color chemistry data (NextSeq/NovaSeq) common in wastewater genomics.

hostile_index_name.description: Name of the Hostile index or path to local index.

hostile_db.description: path to the hostile directory containing host reference and/or indexes.

target_pathogen_options.title: Target pathogen options
target_pathogen_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

target_pathogen_taxid.description: NCBI taxonomy identifiers (taxid or current scientific name) from a file to use as input
target_pathogen_taxid.help_text: NCBI taxonomy identifiers (taxid or current scientific name) from a file to use as input

marker_taxids.description: NCBI taxonomy identifiers (taxid or current scientific name) to be used as marker pathogens
marker_taxids.help_text: NCBI taxonomy identifiers (taxid or current scientific name) to be used as marker pathogens

assembly_source.help_text: The source for assembly genome retrieval - either 'refseq', 'genbank' or 'all'

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts to download genomes
max_attempts.help_text: Maximum number of attempts to download genomes

n_genomes.description: For a single taxid provided, the number of genomes to download
n_genomes.help_text: For a single taxid provided, the number of genomes to download

min_mapq.description: Minimum mapping quality to retain an alignment.
min_mapq.help_text: Lower values allow more reads but increase false positives from cross-mapping.

save_unaligned.description: Save reads that did not map to any pathogen in your database.

pathogen_marker_options.title: Pathogen Marker options
pathogen_marker_options.description: Parameters for pathogen metrics options for reporting

ppmov_threshold.description: PMMoV CPM threshold for Sample Status PASS/FAIL

diversity_window_size.description: Diversity window size in bp to compute nucleotide or Shannon diversity metrics. This is dependent on the genome size of target pathogen

multiple_testing_correction.description: Multiple testing correction type. One of 'bonf', 'holm' or 'fdr'

strand_bias_threshold.description: Maximum p-value allowed, filters out variants with SB p-values below the given threshold

min_allele_freq.description: Minimum allele frequency threshold for calling variant

min_qual_score.description: Minimum Phred-scaled probability that a polymorphism exists at a site

consensus genome annotation_options.title: Consensus genome annotation options
consensus genome annotation_options.description: Options to adjust parameters for binning metagenomes.

genus.description: The target pathogen genus e.g Klebsiella
genus.help_text: Scientific name of the target pathogen genus

species.description: The target pathogen species e.g pneumoniae
species.help_text: Scientific name of the target pathogen species

centre.description: The centre name for prokka annotation
centre.help_text: The centre name for prokka annotation

proteins.description: FASTA file of trusted proteins to first annotate from (optional)

prodigal_tf.description: Training file to use for Prodigal (optional)

regions.description: GFF3 or GenBank file of pre-annotated regions (optional)

hmms.description: HMM database file for custom annotation (optional)

assembly_options.title: Assembly options
assembly_options.description: Options to adjust parameters assembly of metagenomic reads.

kmin.description: Instructs megahit on the minimum kmer size (<= 255), must be odd number

kmax.description: Instructs megahit on the maximum kmer size (<= 255), must be odd number

kstep.description: Instructs megahit on the increment of kmer size of each iteration (<= 28), must be even number

merge_level.description: Instructs megahit on merge complex bubbles of length <= l*kmer_size and similarity >= [20,0.95]

prune_level.description: Instructs megahit on the strength of low depth pruning

low_local_ratio.description: Instructs megahit remove unitigs if its depth is less than this ratio times the average depth of the neighborhoods

min_contig_length.description: minimum length of contigs to output

binning_refinement_options.title: Binning refinement options
binning_refinement_options.description: Options to adjust parameters for binning metagenomes.

maxbin2_min_contig.description: Instructs MaxBin2 to apply a minimum size of a contig for binning.
maxbin2_min_contig.help_text: Minimum size of a contig for binning using MaxBin2.

metabat2_min_contig.description: Instructs MetaBat2 to apply a minimum size of a contig for binning.
metabat2_min_contig.help_text: Minimum size of a contig for binning using MetaBat2.

concoct_min_contig.description: Instructs MaxBin2 to apply a minimum size of a contig for binning.
concoct_min_contig.help_text: Minimum size of a contig for binning using MaxBin2.

score_threshold.description: Score threshold used by until selection algorithm will keep selecting bins

bins_quality_control_and_identification_.title: Bins quality control and identification options
bins_quality_control_and_identification_.description: Options to adjust parameters for quality control of bins and identification with CheckM2, GTDB-Tk, Check and geNomad.

checkm2_db.description: Path to local folder containing already downloaded and uncompressed CheckM2 database.
checkm2_db.help_text: The pipeline can also download this for you if not specified, and you can save the resulting directory into an output directory. You should move this directory to somewhere else on your machine (and supply back to the pipeline in future runs again with `--checkm2_db`.

checkm2_db_zenodo_id.description: Zenodo ID to use for downloading the CheckM2 database.
checkm2_db_zenodo_id.help_text: Zenodo ID to use for downloading the CheckM2 database.

genomad_db.description: Database for virus classification with geNomad
genomad_db.help_text: Must be a directory containing the uncompressed contents from https://portal.nersc.gov/genomad/__data__/genomad_db_v1.1.tar.gz

genomad_min_score.description: Minimum geNomad score for a sequence to be considered viral

genomad_splits.description: Number of groups that geNomad's MMSeqs2 databse should be split into (reduced memory requirements)

checkv_db.description: Database for quality check with CheckV
checkv_db.help_text: Must be a directory containing the uncompressed contents from https://portal.nersc.gov/genomad/__data__/genomad_db_v1.1.tar.gz

MAGs_taxonomic_classification_options.title: Taxonomic classification - GTDB-Tk assigns lineage to bacterial MAGs
MAGs_taxonomic_classification_options.description: Taxonomic classification - GTDB-Tk assigns lineage to bacterial MAGs

gtdb_db.description: Specify the location of a GTDBTK database. Can be either an uncompressed directory or a `.tar.gz` archive. If not specified will be downloaded for you when GTDBTK or binning QC is not skipped.

gtdb_mash.description: Specify the location of a GTDBTK mash database. If missing, GTDB-Tk will skip the ani_screening step

gtdbtk_extension.description: Specify the extension of the bins

gtdbtk_min_completeness.description: Min. bin completeness (in %) required to apply GTDB-tk classification.
gtdbtk_min_completeness.help_text: Completeness assessed with BUSCO analysis (100% - %Missing). Must be greater than 0 (min. 0.01) to avoid GTDB-tk errors. If too low, GTDB-tk classification results can be impaired due to not enough marker genes!

gtdbtk_max_contamination.description: Max. bin contamination (in %) allowed to apply GTDB-tk classification.
gtdbtk_max_contamination.help_text: Contamination approximated based on BUSCO analysis (%Complete and duplicated). If too high, GTDB-tk classification results can be impaired due to contamination!

gtdbtk_min_perc_aa.description: Min. fraction of AA (in %) in the MSA for bins to be kept.

gtdbtk_min_af.description: Min. alignment fraction to consider closest genome.

gtdbtk_pplacer_cpus.description: Number of CPUs used for the by GTDB-Tk run tool pplacer.
gtdbtk_pplacer_cpus.help_text: A low number of CPUs helps to reduce the memory required/reported by GTDB-Tk. See also the [GTDB-Tk documentation](https://ecogenomics.github.io/GTDBTk/faq.html#gtdb-tk-reaches-the-memory-limit-pplacer-crashes).

gtdbtk_pplacer_scratch.description: Reduce GTDB-Tk memory consumption by running pplacer in a setting writing to disk.
gtdbtk_pplacer_scratch.help_text: Will be slower. Set to `false` to turn this off.

abricate_options.title: Abricate Options
abricate_options.description: Parameters for AMR and Virulence screening using Abricate

abricate_dbs.description: Comma-separated list of Abricate databases to use.
abricate_dbs.help_text: Available: carbapenemase, card, ecoh, ecoli_vf, enterobase, megares, ncbi, plasmidfinder, resfinder, vfdb.

amrfinder_options.title: AMRFinder Options
amrfinder_options.description: Parameters for AMR and Virulence screening using AMRFinder

amrfinder_organisms.description: Comma-separated list of AMARFinder supported organisms to use.
amrfinder_organisms.help_text: Available: Acinetobacter, Campylobacter, Enterococcus, Escherichia, Klebsiella, Salmonella, Staphylococcus, Streptococcus, Vibrio.

taxonomic_profiling_options.title: Taxonomic profiling options
taxonomic_profiling_options.description: Parameters for taxonomic profiling using Kraken2

kraken2_db.description: Specify the path to the Kraken 2 DB.

confidence.description: Confidence score threshold (default: 0.0); must be in [0, 1].
confidence.help_text: parameter between 0 and 1 that sets a threshold for classification based on the proportion of matching k-mers, aimed at reducing false positives.

bracken_classification_level.help_text: This specifies that abundance estimation will calculate estimated reads for each species. Other possible options are K (kingdom level), P (phylum), C (class), O (order), F (family), and G (genus).

normalization_scale.description: Normalization scale for Kraken2 relative abundance, computed as the (number of reads/classified reads) * normalization_scale
normalization_scale.help_text: Normalization scale for Kraken2 relative abundance, computed as the (number of reads/classified reads) * normalization_scale

process_skipping_options.title: Process skipping options
process_skipping_options.description: Options to skip various steps within the workflow.

skip_qc.description: Skip all QC steps except for MultiQC.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
